lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three A.M. Your phone won't stop buzzing. Seven sales! You haven't talked to a single buyer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day one. Someone comments price on your reel. Before they can scroll away, your AI closer is already in their DMs.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day four. A buyer says, it's too expensive. The AI doesn't argue. It sends one story, from a student just like her. She buys in nine minutes!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day ten. It sees who clicked the link, and didn't buy. One day later, it follows up. Half of them come back!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day eighteen. Midnight. A stranger is ready to pay. And your AI says... ... no. This isn't the right fit for you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day thirty. Two hundred and twelve sales! Zero sales calls. And the woman it turned away? She came back, with four friends!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sounds far-fetched? A billion people already message a business on Meta's apps, every single week.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Want my DM sales setup? Follow @nxtlvlsocial.ai and comment CLOSE. I'll send you the template.
